Can a first-time customer work out how to book?

Choose a service page someone might reach from search, such as a haircut, kayak rental or pottery class. Review each signal the checker finds in the page HTML. Then open that same URL on your phone, signed out, and try the booking yourself. Pay particular attention to the details that change a customer’s decision before they open the calendar.

Explore appointment booking on Shopify →

Worked example

A pottery class lists $65 and “Book now” near the title. The class length appears only after a time is selected. Adding “90-minute wheel class” beside the price answers a customer’s first question one step earlier.

Shopify Booking Page Checker FAQ

Which Shopify URL should I check?

Use the public page where a customer chooses a service or starts a reservation. A specific product or service page gives a more useful result than the shop homepage or an admin preview.

What does the mobile preview represent?

The preview summarizes information found in the page HTML. You can also try the live page in a phone-sized window when the storefront allows embedding. Open the original on a phone to test the full customer journey.

Why is my booking button marked for review when I can see it?

Some themes and apps add controls after JavaScript runs. Check the page as a customer and confirm whether the button appears, when it appears and where it leads.

Can this checker make a reservation or change my store?

It inspects publicly available page information. You can apply any changes yourself in your theme, product content or booking app, then run another check.

What if my page is password protected?

The checker can only examine the response a visitor can access at that URL. A password screen, storefront challenge or blocked request can hide the actual service details.

Which issue should I address first?

Follow the customer’s path from arrival to selecting a time. If the service has a clear price and duration but the booking action is hard to find, make that action visible and test the path again.
